title: The Self is Formless
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 24.38 Linked Discourses 24.38
  • 2. Dutiyagamanavagga 2. The Second Round

Arūpīattāsutta The Self is Formless

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Kismiṁ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṁ upādāya, kiṁ abhinivissa evaṁ diṭṭhi uppajjati: “Mendicants, when what exists, because of grasping what and insisting on what, does the view arise: ‘arūpī attā hoti arogo paraṁ maraṇā’”ti? ‘The self is formless and healthy after death’?” …

(Peyyālo.)

Vīsatimaṁ.
